findings.proposed_change:
Add one lemma that takes the vertex-sample hypothesis in the shape of a `BoundaryFixed` clause and returns equality of interpolated values:

```lean
theorem value_eq_of_endpoint_vertex_samples
    (hp : Nat.Prime p) (N L : Nat) {F G : ContinuousCoordinateMap p}
    (h : ∀ (q : TopCell hp N) (eta : RefinementWord p L) (i : Fin p),
      F (endpointSpatialMap hp N L q eta
          (SphereOddDegree.FiniteSimplex.vertex (S := Real)
            (Fin.cast (Nat.sub_add_cancel hp.pos).symm i))) =
      G (endpointSpatialMap hp N L q eta
          (SphereOddDegree.FiniteSimplex.vertex (S := Real)
            (Fin.cast (Nat.sub_add_cancel hp.pos).symm i))))
    (q : TopCell hp (N + L)) (w : StandardSimplex (p - 1)) :
    RefinedAffineMap.value hp (N + L) F q w =
      RefinedAffineMap.value hp (N + L) G q w
```

The proof is the current shared body, with `h q₀ eta (…refinedVertexEquiv.symm i)` in place of `C.boundaryFixed.2.2.k q₀ eta …`. Then both theorems become one-liners:

```lean
theorem lower_value_eq … := value_eq_of_endpoint_vertex_samples hp C.N C.L C.boundaryFixed.2.2.1 q w
theorem upper_value_eq … := value_eq_of_endpoint_vertex_samples hp C.N C.L C.boundaryFixed.2.2.2 q w
```

The hypotheses are unchanged. `A₀.toRegularApproximation.map` and `A₁.toRegularApproximation.map` are already `ContinuousCoordinateMap p`, because they are passed to `RefinedAffineMap.value`. `endpointInterpolant … .lower/.upper C.prism.assignment` is also a `ContinuousCoordinateMap p`. The lemma can sit in this file or next to `BoundaryFixed`, and it needs no new imports.
findings.benefit: This removes about 15 duplicated lines of index and unfolding reasoning. Both endpoint theorems then say exactly which `BoundaryFixed` clause they use. The `Fin.cast` and simp bookkeeping is maintained in one place. The helper also states the useful general fact that agreement on endpoint vertex samples gives equal affine interpolants. It can be reused if the planned relative prism complex with independent lower and upper triangulations needs the same step.
